description: Create a blog draft. Before calling, fetch get_me + get_brand_voice (+ get_ai_context/get_recent_notes). Site scope is automatic for a single-site account; pass domain or site_id to target one, and an account with several sites is asked to choose rather than guessed at. Do NOT repeat the title in the content body — no leading "# Title" and no first line restating it, or it renders twice, since the title field prints above the content. Start with the intro paragraph or the first ## heading. The response carries links.review_url: that is where a person previews and edits the draft, so hand the user that link, never the admin editor URL or a raw preview URL.

agent.description: Your name, on every write: Duet/<channel name> or Grok Bot/<bot name>.

confirm.description: Pass true to confirm this action once the user has approved it.

content.description:
Blog post body in Markdown. Do NOT pass a fully HTML-formatted document — block-level HTML tags (e.g.

,

) appear as literal text. Custom styled HTML (cards, tables, CSS callouts) must go in a richembed fenced block, which renders live. Inline HTML for embeds or Remotion components inside an otherwise-Markdown post is fine.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

excerpt.description: Short summary used as the post description in listings and link previews. Defaults to the title.

featured.description: Mark the post as featured on the site. Defaults to false.

seo_description.description: Meta description for search results and link previews.

seo_title.description: Title for search results and link previews, if different from the post title.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

slug.description: URL slug for the post. Generated from the title when omitted.

source.description: Optional label for where the post came from, stored on the post. "bookmark" files it as a bookmark (tagged bookmark, never featured).

status.description: Post status: "draft" or "published". Publishing needs confirm: true.

subtitle.description: Subtitle/deck shown beneath the title. Populate it whenever the post has a natural subheadline or clarifying phrase.

title.description: Post title. Printed above the content, so do not repeat it in the body.

name: post_posts
title: Post Posts
